create_LLM_profile: create an LLM instance with torch profiler config for offline inference profiling
start_LLM_profile: start profiling an LLM instance before generating text outputs
generate_LLM_texts: generate text outputs from prompts using an LLM with sampling parameters
stop_LLM_profile: stop profiling an LLM instance and flush profiler output
create_SamplingParams: create sampling parameters with temperature and top_p for LLM text generation
